verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents API-key-driven programmatic access via REST, a CLI, and MCP. It also offers batch APIs (up to 100 requests per call) with webhooks and scoped restricted API keys, which together support unattended, headless automation of video generation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline usage docs or examples, any detail on the CLI beyond a one-line mention, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
